specificSetting: a regional bus improvement plan planning brief 27

tasks.scenario: Essay discussing priorities for improving bus services in the region
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Unique essay topic on bus improvement; not a reused skeleton. Notes panel with two supplied points plus own idea.

tasks.scenario: Review of a proposed regional bus improvement plan
requiredContentPoints: what the plan aims to do
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Review of a plan, not a facility or event; different from previous review tasks.

tasks.scenario: Article explaining how the bus plan could affect young people
requiredContentPoints: suggest how young people can make their voices heard

tasks.scenario: Email to a friend about the bus plan

requiredContentPoints: how it will affect daily life

overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are based on the same concrete scenario (regional bus improvement plan) but each has a distinct genre, audience, and content points. No reuse of skeletons from previous tests. No forbidden concepts detected.
